title: Protection: Backups & Accounts

freshness.note: options reused from security-ready-2 (split, not new)

pairs.ask: Weekly Encrypted Backup Of Every Repo: Do It Or Not Now?

optionA.label: Do It
optionA.desc: Mirror every WebermanApps repo weekly to an encrypted backup outside GitHub, such as Dropbox or an offline drive. Who does it: Security.

visual.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 240 300" width="240" height="300" style="max-width:100%;height:auto"><rect width="240" height="300" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E5E0D8"/><rect x="0" y="0" width="240" height="8" rx="4" fill="#16a34a"/><text x="18" y="30" font-size="9" fill="#525252" font-family="Hind" font-weight="600">SECURITY</text><text x="18" y="58" font-size="17" fill="#0A0A0A" font-family="Khand" font-weight="700">Do It</text><text x="18" y="108" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">Mirror every WebermanApps repo weekly</text><text x="18" y="123" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">to an encrypted backup outside GitHub,</text><text x="18" y="138" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">such as Dropbox or an offline drive.</text><text x="18" y="153" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">Who does it: Security.</text></svg>

optionB.label: Not Now
optionB.desc: Leave it for now. Why it matters: If GitHub deletes a repo or a login is taken over, there is no copy of the code outside GitHub.

visual.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 240 300" width="240" height="300" style="max-width:100%;height:auto"><rect width="240" height="300" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E5E0D8"/><rect x="0" y="0" width="240" height="8" rx="4" fill="#A3A3A3"/><text x="18" y="30" font-size="9" fill="#525252" font-family="Hind" font-weight="600">SECURITY</text><text x="18" y="58" font-size="17" fill="#0A0A0A" font-family="Khand" font-weight="700">Not Now</text><text x="18" y="108" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">Leave it for now. Why it matters: If</text><text x="18" y="123" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">GitHub deletes a repo or a login is</text><text x="18" y="138" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">taken over, there is no copy of the</text><text x="18" y="153" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">code outside GitHub.</text></svg>

pairs.ask: Print Recovery Codes And Keep Them In A Safe: Do It Or Not Now?

optionA.label: Do It
optionA.desc: Print your recovery codes and keep them offline in a safe. Never store them on the shared computer. Who does it: You.

visual.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 240 300" width="240" height="300" style="max-width:100%;height:auto"><rect width="240" height="300" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E5E0D8"/><rect x="0" y="0" width="240" height="8" rx="4" fill="#16a34a"/><text x="18" y="30" font-size="9" fill="#525252" font-family="Hind" font-weight="600">SECURITY</text><text x="18" y="58" font-size="17" fill="#0A0A0A" font-family="Khand" font-weight="700">Do It</text><text x="18" y="108" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">Print your recovery codes and keep</text><text x="18" y="123" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">them offline in a safe. Never store</text><text x="18" y="138" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">them on the shared computer. Who does</text><text x="18" y="153" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">it: You.</text></svg>

optionB.label: Not Now
optionB.desc: Leave it for now. Why it matters: If a key or phone is lost without recovery codes, you can be locked out of your own company.

visual.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 240 300" width="240" height="300" style="max-width:100%;height:auto"><rect width="240" height="300" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E5E0D8"/><rect x="0" y="0" width="240" height="8" rx="4" fill="#A3A3A3"/><text x="18" y="30" font-size="9" fill="#525252" font-family="Hind" font-weight="600">SECURITY</text><text x="18" y="58" font-size="17" fill="#0A0A0A" font-family="Khand" font-weight="700">Not Now</text><text x="18" y="108" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">Leave it for now. Why it matters: If a</text><text x="18" y="123" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">key or phone is lost without recovery</text><text x="18" y="138" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">codes, you can be locked out of your</text><text x="18" y="153" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">own company.</text></svg>

pairs.ask: Test-Restore One Repo And One File Each Month: Do It Or Not Now?

optionA.label: Do It
optionA.desc: In the monthly review, restore one repo and one Dropbox file from backup and check they open. Who does it: Security.

visual.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 240 300" width="240" height="300" style="max-width:100%;height:auto"><rect width="240" height="300" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E5E0D8"/><rect x="0" y="0" width="240" height="8" rx="4" fill="#16a34a"/><text x="18" y="30" font-size="9" fill="#525252" font-family="Hind" font-weight="600">SECURITY</text><text x="18" y="58" font-size="17" fill="#0A0A0A" font-family="Khand" font-weight="700">Do It</text><text x="18" y="108" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">In the monthly review, restore one</text><text x="18" y="123" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">repo and one Dropbox file from backup</text><text x="18" y="138" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">and check they open. Who does it:</text><text x="18" y="153" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">Security.</text></svg>

optionB.label: Not Now
optionB.desc: Leave it for now. Why it matters: A backup nobody has tested may not work when you need it.

visual.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 240 300" width="240" height="300" style="max-width:100%;height:auto"><rect width="240" height="300" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E5E0D8"/><rect x="0" y="0" width="240" height="8" rx="4" fill="#A3A3A3"/><text x="18" y="30" font-size="9" fill="#525252" font-family="Hind" font-weight="600">SECURITY</text><text x="18" y="58" font-size="17" fill="#0A0A0A" font-family="Khand" font-weight="700">Not Now</text><text x="18" y="108" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">Leave it for now. Why it matters: A</text><text x="18" y="123" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">backup nobody has tested may not work</text><text x="18" y="138" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">when you need it.</text></svg>

pairs.ask: Passkey On The Stripe Account: Do It Or Not Now?

optionA.label: Do It
optionA.desc: Turn on a passkey or hardware key for Stripe before the first real payment, and add Stripe to the 2FA checklist. Who does it: You.

visual.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 240 300" width="240" height="300" style="max-width:100%;height:auto"><rect width="240" height="300" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E5E0D8"/><rect x="0" y="0" width="240" height="8" rx="4" fill="#16a34a"/><text x="18" y="30" font-size="9" fill="#525252" font-family="Hind" font-weight="600">SECURITY</text><text x="18" y="58" font-size="17" fill="#0A0A0A" font-family="Khand" font-weight="700">Do It</text><text x="18" y="108" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">Turn on a passkey or hardware key for</text><text x="18" y="123" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">Stripe before the first real payment,</text><text x="18" y="138" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">and add Stripe to the 2FA checklist.</text><text x="18" y="153" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">Who does it: You.</text></svg>

optionB.label: Not Now
optionB.desc: Leave it for now. Why it matters: Stripe is not on the 2FA checklist yet, but it will hold member payments once smartupkeep.ai launches.

pairs.ask: Two Hardware Keys For Google And GitHub: Do It Or Not Now?

optionA.label: Do It
optionA.desc: Buy two hardware keys (one main, one spare), add them plus a passkey to Google and both GitHub accounts, then turn off SMS fallback. Who does it: You.

visual.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 240 300" width="240" height="300" style="max-width:100%;height:auto"><rect width="240" height="300" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E5E0D8"/><rect x="0" y="0" width="240" height="8" rx="4" fill="#16a34a"/><text x="18" y="30" font-size="9" fill="#525252" font-family="Hind" font-weight="600">SECURITY</text><text x="18" y="58" font-size="17" fill="#0A0A0A" font-family="Khand" font-weight="700">Do It</text><text x="18" y="108" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">Buy two hardware keys (one main, one</text><text x="18" y="123" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">spare), add them plus a passkey to</text><text x="18" y="138" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">Google and both GitHub accounts, then</text><text x="18" y="153" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">turn off SMS fallback. Who does it:</text><text x="18" y="168" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">You.</text></svg>

optionB.label: Not Now
optionB.desc: Leave it for now. Why it matters: Account takeover is the top way to lose everything. SMS codes can be stolen with a SIM swap or a fake login page.

visual.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 240 300" width="240" height="300" style="max-width:100%;height:auto"><rect width="240" height="300" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E5E0D8"/><rect x="0" y="0" width="240" height="8" rx="4" fill="#A3A3A3"/><text x="18" y="30" font-size="9" fill="#525252" font-family="Hind" font-weight="600">SECURITY</text><text x="18" y="58" font-size="17" fill="#0A0A0A" font-family="Khand" font-weight="700">Not Now</text><text x="18" y="108" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">Leave it for now. Why it matters:</text><text x="18" y="123" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">Account takeover is the top way to</text><text x="18" y="138" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">lose everything. SMS codes can be</text><text x="18" y="153" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">stolen with a SIM swap or a fake login</text><text x="18" y="168" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">page.</text></svg>

pairs.ask: Written IP Assignment And NDAs From Helpers: Do It Or Not Now?

optionA.label: Do It
optionA.desc: Use a contractor agreement with an NDA and IP assignment for US and Thai helpers before any new work. Who does it: Legal.

visual.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 240 300" width="240" height="300" style="max-width:100%;height:auto"><rect width="240" height="300" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E5E0D8"/><rect x="0" y="0" width="240" height="8" rx="4" fill="#16a34a"/><text x="18" y="30" font-size="9" fill="#525252" font-family="Hind" font-weight="600">SECURITY</text><text x="18" y="58" font-size="17" fill="#0A0A0A" font-family="Khand" font-weight="700">Do It</text><text x="18" y="108" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">Use a contractor agreement with an NDA</text><text x="18" y="123" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">and IP assignment for US and Thai</text><text x="18" y="138" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">helpers before any new work. Who does</text><text x="18" y="153" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">it: Legal.</text></svg>

optionB.label: Not Now
optionB.desc: Leave it for now. Why it matters: Without a written assignment, contractors can own the code or work they made for you.

visual.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 240 300" width="240" height="300" style="max-width:100%;height:auto"><rect width="240" height="300" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E5E0D8"/><rect x="0" y="0" width="240" height="8" rx="4" fill="#A3A3A3"/><text x="18" y="30" font-size="9" fill="#525252" font-family="Hind" font-weight="600">SECURITY</text><text x="18" y="58" font-size="17" fill="#0A0A0A" font-family="Khand" font-weight="700">Not Now</text><text x="18" y="108" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">Leave it for now. Why it matters:</text><text x="18" y="123" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">Without a written assignment,</text><text x="18" y="138" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">contractors can own the code or work</text><text x="18" y="153" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">they made for you.</text></svg>

pairs.ask: Your OK Before Agents Email, Pay Or Delete: Do It Or Not Now?

optionA.label: Do It
optionA.desc: Agents draft; you approve emails, payments, deletions and pushes to customer sites. Internal dashboards keep publishing on their own. Who does it: All Agents.

visual.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 240 300" width="240" height="300" style="max-width:100%;height:auto"><rect width="240" height="300" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E5E0D8"/><rect x="0" y="0" width="240" height="8" rx="4" fill="#16a34a"/><text x="18" y="30" font-size="9" fill="#525252" font-family="Hind" font-weight="600">SECURITY</text><text x="18" y="58" font-size="17" fill="#0A0A0A" font-family="Khand" font-weight="700">Do It</text><text x="18" y="108" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">Agents draft; you approve emails,</text><text x="18" y="123" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">payments, deletions and pushes to</text><text x="18" y="138" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">customer sites. Internal dashboards</text><text x="18" y="153" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">keep publishing on their own. Who does</text><text x="18" y="168" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">it: All Agents.</text></svg>

optionB.label: Not Now
optionB.desc: Leave it for now. Why it matters: Agents read web pages and email, and hidden instructions in that content can hijack them (prompt injection).

visual.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 240 300" width="240" height="300" style="max-width:100%;height:auto"><rect width="240" height="300" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E5E0D8"/><rect x="0" y="0" width="240" height="8" rx="4" fill="#A3A3A3"/><text x="18" y="30" font-size="9" fill="#525252" font-family="Hind" font-weight="600">SECURITY</text><text x="18" y="58" font-size="17" fill="#0A0A0A" font-family="Khand" font-weight="700">Not Now</text><text x="18" y="108" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">Leave it for now. Why it matters:</text><text x="18" y="123" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">Agents read web pages and email, and</text><text x="18" y="138" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">hidden instructions in that content</text><text x="18" y="153" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">can hijack them (prompt injection).</text></svg>

pairs.ask: Monthly Check Of The GitHub Security Log: Do It Or Not Now?

optionA.label: Do It
optionA.desc: Add a GitHub security log review and a collaborator list check to the monthly review. Who does it: Security.

pairs.ask: Close The Netlify Account After The Takedowns: Do It Or Not Now?

optionA.label: Do It
optionA.desc: Once the three old copies are confirmed down, Security exports any needed files, then you close the Netlify account. Who does it: Security, Then You.

visual.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 240 300" width="240" height="300" style="max-width:100%;height:auto"><rect width="240" height="300" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E5E0D8"/><rect x="0" y="0" width="240" height="8" rx="4" fill="#16a34a"/><text x="18" y="30" font-size="9" fill="#525252" font-family="Hind" font-weight="600">SECURITY</text><text x="18" y="58" font-size="17" fill="#0A0A0A" font-family="Khand" font-weight="700">Do It</text><text x="18" y="108" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">Once the three old copies are</text><text x="18" y="123" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">confirmed down, Security exports any</text><text x="18" y="138" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">needed files, then you close the</text><text x="18" y="153" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">Netlify account. Who does it:</text><text x="18" y="168" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">Security, Then You.</text></svg>

optionB.label: Not Now
optionB.desc: Leave it for now. Why it matters: An unused hosting account is one more login that can be taken over and used to publish.

pairs.ask: Cloudflare Account With 2FA, Ready For A Later Login: Do It Or Not Now?

optionA.label: Do It
optionA.desc: Set up the Cloudflare account with 2FA now, so a login upgrade for smartupkeep.ai is quick later. Nothing changes on the site. Who does it: UpKeep, With Security.
